units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 101a:11">B. Kam. 101ᵃ</cite> <he>וקאתי קוף וכ׳</he> and an ape came and dyed the (stolen) wool (with dye stolen from another person).
Ib. כגון שצבע בהו קופא ed. he painted a (stolen) ape with the stolen paint (so that he improved nothing thereby); [oth. opin. קוִּפָּא basket; Ms. M. קופה, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 1].—Pl. קוֹפִין.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 10:22">Targ. I Kings X, 22</cite>; <cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 9:21">Targ. II Chr. IX, 21</cite>.
